comment: The test of the runtime table, census row E48 of notes/compiler.md 9. Each row changes one part
of the signature of one runtime entry that the emitters call: the name, a parameter type, the
result type, the aggregate of a hidden result or the noreturn state. A row changes the table
rt_sig_of of src/fort/runtime_sig.ft (the side of the call) or the definition in std/rt.ft (the
side of the callee). The test reads the texts and needs no compiler, so the build step only
joins the 4 texts into one file, and the md5 guard reads that file. The stage runs
test/runtime_table_test.py; its log holds a `FAIL:` line of unittest for a caught row. The table
runs on a host with python3 and md5sum, with `--runner 'bash -c'`, or in the VM with the default
build: mkdir -p build && cat src/fort/fir_llvm.ft src/fort/gen.ft src/fort/runtime_sig.ft std/rt.ft > build/runtime-table.sources
